name: @vortyx/deployment-root
description: Deployment glue for the single-project Vercel topology. The root api/[...route].ts catch-all re-uses the real platform API router (platform/api/src/vercel.ts); when VORTYX_STORE=supabase its dynamic import chain reaches @supabase/supabase-js, so the dependency is declared here for the function's module resolution. It is never installed or used by the C++ build, the platform/api tests (which run inside platform/api with their own manifest), or the web console.
